answers.purpose: On demand, help a user choose, run and customise the editorial tools (editorial, editorial-triage, design-consistency, the names and prose checks, /decide): ask what they have and want, print the exact command with its measured cost and next step, start the chosen tool, and say which file customises what at the three levels (workspace rules, document-set profile, one run).

phrases: how do I use the editorial tools
which editorial tool should I use
how do I customise the editorial checks
triggers.disambiguation: Routes and explains only: the editorial skill does the pass, editorial-triage closes findings, design-consistency finds contradictions, /decide asks the questions; this skill picks among them, prints the command and cost, and starts the one chosen. Distinct from /init, which scaffolds CLAUDE.md.
